Process

How We Deliver

Web Design Lane works remotely-first with Colorado clients, which means faster turnarounds and no travel costs padding the invoice.

Discovery

A call to understand your business, your market and what the site actually needs to achieve.

Strategy & Planning

A written plan with scope, timeline, deliverables and the measures we will judge the result against.

Design & Build

Design and development with regular reviews, so you see the work as it develops rather than at the end.

Launch & Support

Testing, refinement and launch, followed by ongoing support to keep the site current.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you work with businesses outside Denver?

Yes, right across Colorado. We work remotely-first, so location makes no difference to responsiveness.

Can you handle booking systems?

Yes. Booking and reservation integration is common in this market and is a standard part of our work.

What does a website cost?

Most business sites run from a few thousand to the low tens of thousands, depending on scope.

How long does it take?

Around six to ten weeks for a business site, longer for ecommerce or booking-heavy builds.
